# Implementation Plan: Unified Navigation & Link Configuration

**Branch**: `003-shared-layout-consistency` | **Date**: 2025-11-05 | **Spec**: `specs/003-shared-layout-consistency/spec.md`  
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/003-shared-layout-consistency/spec.md`

**Note**: This template is generated by `/speckit.plan`. Every decision recorded here MUST reference the Nyan Cat Space constitution and demonstrate compliance before implementation begins.

## Summary

Standardize the cosmic navigation and footer so every page honors the constitution’s clarity and accessibility gates. We will extract the header and footer into shared partials (static include fragments) consumed by each HTML page, bind nav/social URLs to a lightweight config file, and adjust `about.html` to reuse the sitewide container (`max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6`). This keeps the retro terminal vibe consistent (Principle I), simplifies upkeep (Principle II), and ensures visitors never lose orientation (Principle V).

## Technical Context

**Languages**: HTML5, Tailwind CSS utilities, vanilla JavaScript (ES2020)  
**Dependencies**: `styles/tailwind.css` (hand-authored utility set); no build tooling, frameworks, or external JS libraries  
**Assets**: Media stored under `assets/`; individual files ≤ 200KB unless a variance is justified in Constitution Check  
**Validation**: Manual accessibility sweeps (keyboard navigation, contrast, reduced motion), responsive testing across mobile/desktop, optional automated linting if available  
**Target Platforms**: Evergreen desktop/mobile browsers, graceful fallback with JavaScript disabled  
**Performance Goals**: First meaningful paint < 2s on LTE, animation frame budgets ≤ 16ms, zero blocking network requests after initial page load  
**Constraints**: Preserve retro terminal aesthetic, respect prefers-reduced-motion, stay fully static, maintain accessible content hierarchy  
**Scope**: Static site with `index.html`, `about.html`, `projects.html`, `blog.html`, `contact.html`, shared assets under `styles/` and `scripts/`

## Constitution Check

- **Terminal Fidelity**: Shared header/footer will reuse existing neon palette and monospace typography. Any new utility classes (e.g., `.footer-link`) will borrow from `styles/tailwind.css` tokens to stay within the cosmic palette.  
- **Cosmic Performance & Simplicity**: Partial includes are plain HTML snippets; config lives in a static JSON/JS file read by existing scripts (no bundler). Eliminates content drift without adding runtime weight.  
- **Universal Accessibility**: Skip links, `aria-current`, and landmark semantics will persist in the shared header/footer. We’ll re-check keyboard traversal post-refactor and document results in the quickstart.  
- **Playful Animation Discipline**: No new animations introduced; existing hover transitions remain CSS-only and still respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.  
- **Narrative & Content Clarity**: Consistent navigation keeps story beats discoverable. Containing the About page ensures readable line lengths and maintains narrative pacing.

**Structure Decision**: Introduce `partials/` for shared header/footer fragments and `config/links.json` for contact handles. These additions align with Principle II by keeping maintenance centralized while preserving the static site architecture (no server-side includes; we will inline via build step or manual copy during implementation).
